name: Menu Game Shaders
description: Applies music & BPM reactive shaders and visual effects to the main menu background (MenuGameLayer).

enabled.name: Enable Mod
enabled.description: Toggle menu shaders on or off.

shader-style.name: Shader Style
shader-style.description:
Select the visual shader style:
0. Shockwave Pulse (GD 2.2 Sneak Peek style)
1. Audio Waves (Sound frequency ripples)
2. Beat Bulge & Warp (Pinch / bulge pulse)
3. Neon Chromatic Beat (RGB split)
4. Glitch & Scanline Pulse
5. Liquid Ripples (Dreamy water waves)
6. Radial Audio Equalizer (Pulsing frequency ring)
7. Hyperspace Warp Tunnel (Cosmic speed rush)
8. Retro CRT Arcade / Cyberpunk (Scanlines & curvature)
9. Kaleidoscope Dimension (8-fold crystal symmetry)
10. Pixel Crunch Matrix (8-Bit mosaic dither)
11. Gravitational Vortex / Black Hole (Hypnotic twist)

audio-reactive.name: Music & Beat Reactivity
audio-reactive.description: Extract live bass, transients and spectral flux from background music to drive shaders in real time.

beat-sensitivity.name: Beat Detection Sensitivity
beat-sensitivity.description: How strictly or easily music transients and kick drums trigger beat explosions.

pulse-intensity.name: Beat Pulse Intensity
pulse-intensity.description: How strongly the shaders react to music beats and kicks.

bass-shake.name: Bass Camera Shake
bass-shake.description: Adds physical screen impact and camera bump on heavy kick drops.

beat-flash.name: Beat Strobe Flash
beat-flash.description: Adds subtle luminescence strobe on heavy beat drops.

distortion-strength.name: Distortion Strength
distortion-strength.description: Controls the magnitude of waves, ripples, and warp deformations.

speed.name: Animation Speed
speed.description: Speed multiplier for time-based shader animations.

bpm.name: Tempo Fallback (BPM)
bpm.description: Base rhythm tempo in beats per minute when music is silent or in menus without audio.

color-tint-mode.name: Color Tint Mode
color-tint-mode.description:
Background color tinting style:
0. Original (No tint)
1. Sneak Peek Cycle (Purple -> Pink -> Cyan -> Green)
2. Purple / Violet (Sneak Peek 1)
3. Neon Pink / Magenta (Sneak Peek 2)
4. Acid Green (Sneak Peek 3)
5. Custom Color

custom-color.name: Custom Color
custom-color.description: Custom tint color when Color Tint Mode is set to 5.

chromatic-aberration.name: Chromatic Aberration
chromatic-aberration.description: Add subtle RGB channel separation along wave edges on beat.
